svg.aria-label: os-xgs-npu status. Stage: discovery, front ports and offload done; integration and testing in progress; the repository notice not yet lifted. XGS 3300, Cavium OCTEON TX: 12 of 12 front ports and the module's, flow offload with 99.6 per cent of frames in hardware, IPsec offload with GCM, CBC, NAT-T and IPv6, sensors, front panel and first boot, a built image booted from disk; measured: IPsec at 1.85 Gbit/s at MTU 1500, the same as clear text, 7.41 Gbit/s on one stream at MTU 9000, and 99.6 per cent of frames in hardware; weighted completion 95 per cent. XGS 136, Marvell CN9131: 14 of 14 front ports, flow offload by the sweep, IPsec offload with GCM, CBC and NAT-T, first boot by the chassis names, integration in progress; measured: clear text 773 Mbit/s in and 934 out, IPsec 902 Mbit/s at MTU 1500 and 982 at MTU 9000 over a gigabit link; weighted completion 91 per cent. OCTEON TX2 and TX2 98XX described only; TOPAZ and GR have no coprocessor. 2,391 GiB over TLS with no byte changed; 6,100 give-backs revived, none refused; ten claims withdrawn and nineteen dead ends recorded. Figures were measured with iperf3 into the appliance host through a hardware IPsec peer.
